status: Conditional geometric maneuvering screen; not accessibility acceptance or physical wheelchair validation
search_modes: Forward/reverse 3 in segments parallel to current heading, with in-place axle pivots. Bay 1 uses a 7.5 degree heading lattice with its shunting tail replaced by a reverse circular arc; Bay 2 uses 15 degrees. No sideways translations.
obstacle_basis: All fixed-seat envelopes and 9.5 in forward leg reservations; full stowed strips; coach walls,42in structural side opening and36in clear boarding corridor; final bridge curbs, hinge ears and conservative full guard footprints; complete proxy enters straight before turning; other occupied 30 x 48 in proxy. Both folding seats fully stowed except separate other-folding-seat proxy screen.

reports.exit: Exact time reversal follows same collision-free sweep; controls and crew assistance are not validated.

limits: Actual mobility devices can exceed30x48in and have different axle/caster locations; validate representativedevicefamilies andfull-size mockup.
Pivots assume differential-wheel ability aroundrearaxle; self-propelled/assisted operation, caster sweep, anti-tip hardware andfootrests arenot separately validated.

Bridge curbs and handrails, open door fixed obstacles and other-bay retractor reservations included; active bay retractors removed during access. Actual threshold gaps and caster behavior require full-size trials.
Parked shoulder locations andcompanion alignment are illustrative, not anthropometric acceptance.

Search and analytic arc prove existence for this proxy only. Both approaches use one travel-direction reversal; steering steps are geometric paths, not operating instructions. Practical controls, effort and usability still need full-size trials.
sampling_bound_note: The reserve is the maximum of half the0.25in translation interval and the largest corner radius about each actual rotation center times half the0.25degree angular interval. For a reverse arc, radius=sqrt(36^2+(15+R)^2); the actual radius is calculated for each arc, and0.125in remains governing for the current paths.
layout_change_experiment_disposition: A two-inch longer first bay was considered but not adopted. Analytic arc smoothing resolved lattice-induced shunting within the original60x36in bay.
